lines.en: I don't walk; I glide.

lines.zh: 我在草上滑行，草叶没弯。
lines.en: I glide over the grass and it doesn't bend.
My wings are spread wide.
I ride the wind, fast.

lines.zh: 我从这块石头滑到那块。
lines.en: I glide from stone to stone.
I don't land; I drift low.
I lift a little higher.
I skim the hillside.
My body is very light.
I bank, and the wind follows.
I pause on the current.

lines.zh: 风托着我，从山脊滑到草原。
lines.en: The wind carries me from the ridge down to the plains.
I hover above the grass.
My wings barely move.
I wait for a rising gust.
I tilt as if on a string.
My tail sways in the air.

lines.zh: 我在看下面有没有吃的。
lines.en: I look below for food.
I put myself in the draught.
I stay still; the wind holds me.
I survey the whole plain from above.
I bank around with the wind.
There are fine hairs on my wing edges.
I found a shadow on the grass.
I spread my wings as wide as they go.
I don't land; I only drift.
My shadow slides over the grass.
I am counting wind directions.
My tail is like a cord.
Did you look up for me?
I am above your head.
Your scent drifts up to me.
I could land on your shoulder.
Don't move suddenly.
I circle you once, close in.
I fly low so you can see.

lines.zh: 你手上的东西给我看看。
lines.en: Let me see what you hold.

lines.zh: 风把你的味道带上来了。
lines.en: The wind carried your scent up.

lines.zh: 你的头发被我的翅膀吹动了。
lines.en: My wings stir your hair.
Shall I take you somewhere?

lines.zh: 你可以伸手，我会碰一下。
lines.en: Put out your hand; I'll touch it.
I'm checking whether you stand firm.
I drop a little in the air.
I struggle to steady.

lines.zh: 我落到石头上歇了一下。
lines.en: I land on a stone to rest.

lines.zh: 翅膀抖乱了，我重新找平衡。
lines.en: My wings stutter; I find my balance again.
That slowed my flight.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀重新撑到最开。
lines.en: I spread my wings wide again.
This won't stop a glide.
I climb a little.
Is that raw chicken down there?
Hold it up; I'll come down.
I land on your arm.
Keep your hand still; I'm landing.
I take one small bite from your palm.
There's raw meat in the air.

lines.zh: 你留着自己吃吧，我不抢。
lines.en: Keep it; I won't snatch.
A little higher.
I'll snatch it and fly off.
You may stroke my back.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我从空中偏了一下。
lines.en: You hit me and I veer off.
I am light; a bump makes no sound.
You walk underneath me.
My claws touch your head.
I climb into a higher current.

lines.zh: 我们碰了一下，我稳住了。
lines.en: We touched and I steadied.
Don't wave around underneath.
I land beside you.
I move aside; the wind remains.
My kind flies high.
You can't reach my height.
I'll follow you a while, that's enough.
I wait for you in the draught.
You needn't hold on to me.
I have folded my wings.
We are a quiet kind.
I settle in your shadow.
I dive and snatch it.
I grab it from the air.
Too heavy; I can't lift it.
I carry it back to where I was.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，我盘旋一圈再看。
lines.en: For things on the ground, I circle once first.
This could line a nest.
I let go and it drops.
I carry it up.
This isn't raw meat.

lines.zh: 我落在石头上，把它放下。
lines.en: I land on the stone and set it down.
I slide down out of the current.
You can't outrun the wind.
I'll come from behind.
Looking up was the right idea.
I ride the current above you.

lines.zh: 翅膀声就在你帽子上方。
lines.en: Wings, right above your hat.

lines.zh: 我落在一块石头上看你。
lines.en: I land on a stone and watch you.
The wind favours me here.

lines.zh: 我绕着圈，一圈比一圈低。
lines.en: I circle, lower each turn.
Turn, and I rise.

lines.zh: 我的影子在你脚边移动。
lines.en: My shadow moves at your feet.
The wind has changed note.
I stand on the current.

lines.zh: 你躲在树下，树枝挡不住。
lines.en: You hide under a tree; the branches won't stop me.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶盘旋，翅膀不出声。
lines.en: I circle above your head, wings silent.
I skim along the hillside.
I glide a little lower.
I rake down with a claw.
I ram you from above.

lines.zh: 这一抓压上了下落的速度。
lines.en: That rake carried my fall.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的肩就往上提。
lines.en: I grab your shoulder and pull up.
You stumble as I pull.
I hit your back.

lines.zh: 我的爪子勾住你的衣领。
lines.en: My claws hook your collar.
I shake and you go off balance.
I climb back up at once.
The wind carried me in.
My wings are still shivering.
These plains are wide open.
I land on the grass, lightly.
I look for a rising current.

lines.zh: 山地和草原交界处最好。
lines.en: The hill-and-plain border is best.
I shake the pollen off my wings.
I rose slowly.
The wind is steady here.
I'll stay in the air.
I picked a tall tree.
I hear a call far off.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀被火燎到，飞低了。
lines.en: Fire singes my wing and I fly lower.

lines.zh: 翼膜湿透了，我只能贴着地爬。
lines.en: My wing membranes are soaked; I can only crawl.
The blast tumbles me in midair.
A hole is punched through my wing.
Spell-light weighs my wings down.
Too hungry to lift myself.
The thunder drives me low.
The wind is gone and I keep falling.
